name: Ming Tsai
headline: Developer Lead building software ideas in the open.
bio: I'm a full-stack developer with a backend focus, based in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, with about 9 years of experience. I've been leading teams since 2020, first as Scrum Master and, since 2022, as Developer Lead at a large company in the beverage industry. I lead a team of 3 to 4 developers, run code reviews and set coding standards.

I use AI tools to improve code quality and to automate routine work such as pull request reviews, user stories and release notes. I also build AI agents: one, written in Python, resolves, routes or escalates customer support tickets. I gave my team an introductory training on generative AI.
I have a BSc in Systems Engineering. In 2024 I completed a Master's in Cybercrime at Nebrija University in Spain.
Kreanto is my studio for side projects: what I'm building, what works, and what I archived.
